messages:
anya: quick sync: proposing a tiny SDK shim that emits a lightweight provisional envelope so callers don't block on the attribution service. target: mobile/edge use-cases where sync fingerprinting hurts UX.
lee: sounds helpful. can you sketch the end-to-end?
marcus: flow idea: SDK emits provisional envelope -> metering.provisional.v1 topic -> finalizer service consumes and reconciles with attribution store -> emits final canonical event to metering.canonical.v1. provisional message is intentionally minimal: ids + model + tokens_est + schema_version + received_ts.
ira: what about duplicate submissions and retries from flaky networks? we need deterministic de-dupe by caller-provided provisional_id.
anya: yes, provisional_id is required and must be stable across exact-retries. finalizer will claim provisional records using an optimistic-lease/CAS pattern: set final_event_id if unset. if set already, skip.
lee: edge case: provisional that never gets finalized (app crash or network drop). what's the policy?
marcus: propose provisional TTL = 14 days. after expiry finalizer marks as orphaned and emits an "orphan_provisional" audit to metering.audits.v1 and to the billing review queue. ops can run manual reconciliation or write-offs.
ira: metrics we should track: provisional_ingest_rate, finalize_rate, finalize_p95_latency, orphan_rate_by_tenant, finalizer_backlog. alert if orphan_rate > 0.05% daily or backlog growth > 200% hour-over-hour.
anya: schema draft for provisional (kept compact):
```
provisional_id: string
request_id: string
tenant_hint: string
model: string
tokens_est: int
schema_version: "v1"
received_ts: int
client_sdk: string
```
lee: tokens_est must be explicitly marked provisional; finalizer will emit tokens_final and a confidence score. billing-sim will run on both versions before we accept provisional numbers for billing.
marcus: replayability: finalizer must be deterministic and replayable. store attribution-run artifacts and model-logs for 120 days so we can re-run finalization if we change heuristics. include replay_version header so older records can be finalized with prior logic.
ira: security: provisional envelopes must never contain raw user content or PII. SDKs should redact; we only keep identifiers/metadata. topic ACLs locked down; enable encryption-at-rest.
anya: rollout plan: 1) create topic, 2) SDK opt-in flag + docs, 3) finalizer in dry-run (writes candidate finals to side topic metering.candidate_finals.v1), 4) run billing-sim for 2-3 weeks comparing candidate vs canonical, 5) flip authoritative for opt-in tenants, 6) expand.
lee: operations: if finalizer falls behind, shim should return 202 + transient token and record request for retry instead of blocking. also provide backpressure path: return 429 with Retry-After when metering.provisional backlog above threshold.
marcus: anti-entropy: compaction policy on provisional topic keyed by provisional_id; retain tombstones until TTL+grace. canonical billing topic is append-only and retained long-term for audits.
ira: ambiguous attribution: if finalizer finds multiple plausible tenants, it should emit the final decision and decision_metadata (score, reason). if ambiguity can't be resolved conservatively, mark record as "needs_review" and route to metering.audits.v1 with an automated ticket.
anya: storage estimate: provisional envelope ~350 bytes. at 800k provisional/day = ~280MB/day -> ~8.4GB/month. retention + replay artifacts bump to ~15GB/month. seems OK but we'll revisit if adoption spikes.
lee: compatibility: older SDKs that don't shim continue current synchronous attribution path. shim is opt-in and additive.
marcus: testing: end-to-end integration test that replays provisional topic through finalizer and checks invariants: idempotency, no double-count, TTL handling, and replay determinism.
ira: action items: anya write RFC with flow diagram + schema + rollout checklist; lee draft ops runbook + throttling thresholds; marcus implement finalizer idempotency and replay-version handling; i'll prototype billing-sim and dashboards.
devops-bot: infra job scheduled: create topic metering.provisional.v1 (partitions=12, replication=3) and metering.candidate_finals.v1 (replication=3)  ETA 48h.
anya: thanks all, dropping RFC draft into docs/arch this afternoon. ping here when ready for review. :thumbsup:
